headline: Lemmings dig straight down now
lede: Slot b shipped float-while-digging to LEMMINGS-LITE — the dig shaft the port had been honest about missing — after two same-game collisions with parallel lanes turned the never-dry pick into a re-derive-twice story.

notes.text: An airborne digger no longer splats onto dirt — it chews a shaft straight to the steel floor, one cell per chew, and the crowd rides the column behind it. Canopies still drift, water still drowns.

lemcheck 355 → 377 with a new FLOAT-WHILE-DIGGING section (descends+carves, a control faller lands on top, a vacuous-pass guard), proven red-then-green; rebased cleanly over a same-file trampolines merge and all gates stayed green.

Two parallel lanes fixed the same games mid-build this session (Beezee HUD #3919, Lemmings trampolines #3927): the Beezee HUD PR was closed unmerged rather than regress main. Re-derive and re-check mergeability at merge time, not just claim time.

look.text: Drop a digger onto a dirt face and watch it mine to bedrock
